title: W041--Temporary Chiller Rental
agency_path: VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.246-NETWORK CONTRACTING OFFICE 6 (36C246)
detail_text: The Department of Veterans Affairs, Network Contracting Office (NCO) 6, intends to negotiate a sole source contract with Sunbelt Rentals for an urgent Temporary Chiller for the Asheville VA Medical Center in Asheville, NC. Period of performance will be Five Months. Justification for this sole source procurement is in accordance with FAR 12.102 Restricting competition. This notice of intent is not a request for competitive quotes. No solicitation documents are available, and telephone requests will not be accepted. However, any business that believes it can meet these requirements and possesses relevant past experience, and expertise may give written notice. Supporting evidence must be furnished in sufficient detail to demonstrate the ability to comply with the above requirement. Responses will be considered by the Government, however, a determination by the Government not to compete the proposed acquisition based upon responses of this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. NAICS Code 238220 / $19 million. Responses received by 10:00 am EST on April 27, 2026, will be considered by the Government. Inquiries shall be emailed to Emily.Donahue@va.gov. No telephone requests will be accepted.
